units.source_text: 我停住脚步，是在我经过那里向主楼西侧走去，来到挂着"工作室"牌子的花道部小屋前的时候。

en.t: I stopped in my tracks when I had passed that place and was walking toward the west side of the main building, just as I came in front of the flower arrangement club hut with a sign reading "Studio" hanging on it.

units.source_text: 沿墙耸立的成排樟树，越过小屋屋顶，把透过阳光的细小的叶影，映现在主楼的红砖墙上。

en.t: The rows of camphor trees rising along the wall reached over the hut roof and cast tiny sunlit leaf shadows onto the red brick wall of the main building.

units.source_text: 沐裕着夕照的红砖美极了。

en.t: The red bricks bathed in the evening light were extraordinarily beautiful.
